title: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomics with machine learning identify a Luminal-inflam malignant program and reveal an RPN1-PERK UPR vulnerability in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Wu, Jinpeng; Fan, Jingjing; Sha, Tong; Li, Hongtao
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞与空间转录组及机器学习识别三阴性乳腺癌恶性亚群和RPN1相关应激脆弱性，虽涉及转录因子活性推断，但核心是肿瘤分型与预后标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer is marked by extensive cellular heterogeneity and limited availability of actionable targeted treatments, which contributes to an unfavorable prognosis. In this work, single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling was integrated with network-based analyses and machine-learning approaches to characterize malignant epithelial programs in TNBC and to pinpoint prognostic biomarkers.Single-cell RNA sequencing identified a malignant epithelial subpopulation, Luminal_inflam, characterized by elevated inferred copy number variation, a terminal pseudotime state, and enrichment of cell cycle-associated transcriptional programs. Cell-cell communication analysis indicated microenvironmental remodeling in TNBC and prioritized a fibroblast-associated S100A4-EGFR axis that may regulate Luminal_inflam-associated gene expression. Gene regulatory network analysis further revealed increased activities of transcription factors including MYBL2, TFDP1, CEBPD, and MBD2. A 12-gene risk signature constructed from Luminal_inflam-associated modules and survival cohorts effectively stratified overall survival and captured differences in immune features and potential drug sensitivities. In our MDA-MB-231 model, RPN1 knockdown was associated with reduced cell viability, which could be partially rescued by 4-PBA. We further found that RPN1 depletion was accompanied by increased intracellular ROS and Ca(2+) levels, altered cell-cycle distribution, and elevated apoptosis, and that these changes were also partially reversible upon 4-PBA treatment. These data support the view that loss of RPN1 perturbs ER homeostasis and is linked to stress-associated cell fate changes in TNBC cells. At the same time, these findings should be interpreted in the context of prior work showing that RPN1 depletion can induce ER-stress-dependent apoptosis in breast cancer models. Thus, rather than establishing an entirely new mechanism, our study extends previous observations by connecting this stress-related phenotype to a specific malignant epithelial program and a clinically derived risk framework.Collectively, this study delineates a key malignant epithelial state in TNBC and suggests that RPN1-associated proteostasis vulnerability may represent a potential therapeutic opportunity.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌以广泛的细胞异质性和可操作的靶向治疗手段有限为特征，这导致了不良预后。在本研究中，单细胞和空间转录组分析结合基于网络的分析和机器学习方法，用于表征TNBC中的恶性上皮程序并识别预后生物标志物。单细胞RNA测序鉴定出一个恶性上皮亚群，即Luminal_inflam，其特征为推断拷贝数变异升高、拟时间终末状态以及细胞周期相关转录程序的富集。细胞间通讯分析表明TNBC中微环境重塑，并优先确定了成纤维细胞相关的S100A4-EGFR轴，该轴可能调节Luminal_inflam相关基因表达。基因调控网络分析进一步揭示了包括MYBL2、TFDP1、CEBPD和MBD2在内的转录因子活性增加。由Luminal_inflam相关模块和生存队列构建的12基因风险特征有效分层了总生存期，并捕捉了免疫特征和潜在药物敏感性的差异。在我们的MDA-MB-231模型中，RPN1敲低与细胞活力降低相关，这种效应可部分被4-PBA挽救。我们进一步发现，RPN1缺失伴随细胞内ROS和Ca(2+)水平升高、细胞周期分布改变以及凋亡增加，并且这些变化在4-PBA处理后也部分可逆。这些数据支持以下观点：RPN1缺失扰乱内质网稳态，并与TNBC细胞中应激相关的细胞命运变化相关联。同时，这些发现应在先前工作的背景下解读，该工作显示RPN1缺失可诱导乳腺癌模型中的内质网应激依赖性凋亡。因此，我们的研究并非建立全新机制，而是通过将这种应激相关表型与特定恶性上皮程序和临床衍生风险框架联系起来，扩展了先前的观察。总体而言，本研究描绘了TNBC中的一个关键恶性上皮状态，并提示RPN1相关的蛋白质稳态脆弱性可能代表潜在的治疗机会。
